answer: The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in saffron, expire in pigment, and mesa lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 48 aliases as a result needs 95 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1241 identities would post 4346 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
